# QODE

> QODE turns text or a link into a circular hexagon code with three dot states, and reads it live with your phone camera, right in the browser. Made by Sherin Varghese (https://sherin.fun).

- [Create a Qode](https://qode.sherin.fun/generator): type text or a link and save or share the code.
- [Scan a Qode](https://qode.sherin.fun/scanner): point your phone camera at a code, or upload an image.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Red-Blue-co/qode)
